THE ROUTING TABLE VS WHAT IS BUILT (filed 2026-08-12 from the mechanics catalog, Part 7, session d0a3e5cd). His table assigns every NESI floor a grammar, a camera and a way in: apex = inscription in a fixed-camera chamber; spire descent = THE LIFT as meaningful travel with gates on its stops; dam floor = order-and-timing with the pipe model; ground = terraform-and-tend in a bounded-follow chamber carrying inscriptions to where they embed; one dark raycast 3D chamber. SEVERAL ASSIGNMENTS DO NOT MATCH THE BUILD: the four stations are panels opened from the world, not chambers with their own way in; there is no lift and so no meaningful travel between floors; the dam has no pipe model; nothing routes a written sentence to where it embeds in the ground (rung four). This is a large reconciliation between his design and the built shape, not a defect list - and it needs his mark on what is design intent versus what the build has already superseded, before any of it becomes work.
